metadata.evidence_semantics: Embedded historical records are immutable observations. Their old path strings are origin labels, not live dependencies. Use only this manifest's files.
metadata.proof_boundary: Preserved text, feedback and actual observed image/audio evidence. Does not preserve every full-video frame or make unobserved claims pass.
metadata.observation_selection: Native representative frames, explicit failures, declared review evidence and caption/audio boundaries; full production audits stay in delivery/recovery assets.
